title: Pachinko
author: Min Jin Lee
summary: Starting in a Korean fishing village in the early twentieth century, the novel follows one family across four generations as they move to Japan and struggle with discrimination, poverty and ambition.
readIf: you like generational sagas that show history through the daily choices of ordinary people.
skipIf: you want a single clear protagonist, or a book without a lot of loss and hardship.

pairings.reason: Another multi-decade story of resilient people under heavy social pressure, with similar emotional force.
A big family saga with a medical backdrop and a similar mix of tragedy and hope.
Another look at Japan through the eyes of a woman from a poor background, in a more glossy, romantic register.
